changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS public.retailer_size_band_id_seq INCREMENT BY 1 NO MINVALUE NO MAXVALUE START WITH 1 CACHE 1; CREATE TABLE public.retailer_size_band ( id bigint DEFAULT nextval('public.retailer_size_band_id_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL, retailer_type_code character varying(64) NOT NULL, code character varying(64) NOT NULL, label character varying(255) NOT NULL, min_locations integer NOT NULL, max_locations integer, sort_order integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, is_active boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL, created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT retailer_size_band_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT ux_retailer_size_band__type_code UNIQUE (retailer_type_code, code), CONSTRAINT chk_retailer_size_band__range CHECK (max_locations IS NULL OR max_locations >= min_locations) ); COMMENT ON TABLE public.retailer_size_band IS 'Size band for one retailer_type. Chosen from the retail_location count for that pack. Fuel rules ignore the band.'; ALTER TABLE public.tenant_organization ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS retailer_size_band_code character varying(64); COMMENT ON COLUMN public.tenant_organization.retailer_size_band_code IS 'Optional size-band override. Empty means the band is computed from the location count.';
